name: sistema-practicas-preprofesionales
description: Sistema de Gestión de Prácticas Preprofesionales ISTPET

scripts.fix:setup: powershell -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne $PID } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; rd -s -q node_modules\.prisma; npm run setup"
scripts.info: powershell -Command "Start-Sleep -s 8; Write-Host '' ; Write-Host '===================================================' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   SISTEMA PRAXIS HUB - ACCESOS DIRECTOS (LOCAL)   ' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '===================================================' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ' FRONTEND: http://localhost:3005' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ' BACKEND:  http://localhost:5000' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '===================================================' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:front" "npm run info"
